Temporary Halloween/holiday playlist secrets and their event-specific reward changes have not been fully audited. Permanent map quests are documented separately.

The full radio / Ancient Ruin / speaking-stone dialogue archive and every lore pickup interaction are not transcribed. The authored story, listed side quests, weapon upgrades and verified song triggers remain available.

Post Office extraction and the Maintenance Tower / Infinite Cosmos chain are documented. Reports of other blue Al Bagra-style keys and additional Season 5 locked loot rooms remain uncorroborated; no guaranteed route is supplied for them.

The finale missions, named bosses, six triangle rituals, eight free-perk challenges, chess vault, grave, dog and weapon upgrade routes are documented. This is not a complete transcription of every prerequisite Act I–III task's individual objective list or ordinary mission reward table.

The stock Molotov no-refill behavior is documented, but exact capacity and re-acquisition still need primary proof. The twelve-track radio inventory has not been independently checked by listening through the full in-game sequence.

JokerAlex21 indexes a ZoneX video. The accessible primary index does not expose those mechanics; crystal tier, reset and failure conditions remain uncorroborated.
Flute-statue/pipe speculation: Community discussion exists but no supported completion route or reward was established. No invented reward or solved quest is staged.

All free equipment candidate photographs: The six-location source card is retained, but independent illustrated evidence was not located for every Molotov/Combat Axe candidate. See that card's per-guide limitations.

Exact switch formula, S.A.M. health fractions and score equality: Instructions follow lit controls/completion feedback and exceed the score threshold; they do not certify source-disputed counts or fractions.

All 33 existing cards were source-compared; 294 selected location photos and individual 24/25-item intel checklists were added. No independent gameplay run was performed. Exact timers, save/resume behavior, shared rewards, final-build balance and mode/platform edge cases remain unchecked.

The optional harder boss routes recommend entry on round 101 or later to satisfy conflicting at-100/after-100 descriptions. This is a conservative entry route, not a claim that round 100 cannot work. Reckoning’s two ordinary boss choices require separate runs.

Remaining three story-radio close-ups: The five-recording inventory is documented, but exact readable BO1 close-ups for the PM63 flooded-walkway radio, Double Tap radio and Speed Cola water-rock radio were not obtained. Lighthouse floor trigger has firsthand prose but no selected close-up. Do not publish “near Double Tap” as a completed full walkthrough.

Saved-credit ownership in co-op: Sources disagree whether Stand-in alone in co-op is sufficient and whether eligibility checks host, killer or another player. Solo Stand-in and current-match reward are corroborated; exact mixed-credit lobby combinations were not tested.

George health and return timing: Exact health scaling, defeat-return timing, base-VR calm time, Lazarus banishment duration and one-versus-multiple banishment shots lack controlled original-build measurements. All fixed timers and guaranteed Dragunov-magazine kill budgets are omitted.

Scavenger/Hyena damage and blast radius: Primary player weapon guides directly conflict about damage doubling and blast-radius growth. Only name, ammunition, PaP transaction and thermal scope are retained.

Lazarus explosion and teammate buff: Monkey says two shots; multiple BO1 player sources say three and Nosfrat says two or three. This batch has no continuous counted-shot footage. Exact teammate protection/kill-boost durations and shared points also remain unmeasured.

Electrified-zombie bonus ammo schedule: Repeated firsthand observations establish the mechanic; exact randomized cooldown and eligible-kill counter remain unverified. A fixed “every five rounds” statement is explicitly rejected.

Pack-a-Punch cycle and transaction boundary: Three sites are corroborated and photographed. Exact active/absent durations, cycle randomness and whether a pending transaction prevents sinking were not tested. hXcHector’s four-rock count is rejected.

Flinger/cable approach photos and cooldown: Text supports both one-way cables and Flinger prerequisites. Current selected images show approaches rather than close-up Flinger controls/cable catches. The GameYum image labeled Flinger actually shows actors on a railing and is rejected as operational evidence. No exact cooldown is asserted.

Map pictures, Vril chart and ship test-subject containers: Firsthand source descriptions mention earlier-map pictures in/under PhD, the Vril wall chart and test-subject containers near the ship. No complete local photo route or reproducible interaction/reward is established here. The band poster is photographed and staged as scenery only.

Scavenger distance achievement: The achievement requires ten kills with one Scavenger shot from over100feet. A measured self-contained staging/shooting position was not verified in this pass; no exact landmark route is staged.

Remaining ordinary gun upgrade matrix: Base wall/Box inventory was read in hXcHector; the three utility upgrades and Ray Gun are supplied. The entire ordinary-gun PaP name/ammunition/attachment matrix was not independently checked per weapon, and no map-complete ordinary upgrade claim is made.

All perk purchases and patch/platform differences: Early BO1 sources list seven perks while patched builds also include Mule Kick. Exact PC Deadshot price/aim behavior, Mule Kick build availability and every perk-loss/rebuy combination were not source-audited per platform here.

Freezing and teammate release: Original firsthand prose confirms water slows/freezes players and zombies. Exact freeze time and teammate release interaction were not independently demonstrated. No full timed freezing/rescue card is staged.

Doll damage and technical limits: Three inventory uses, four cluster explosions and lack of PaP upgrade are corroborated. No exact damage-per-explosion, George multiplier or object/entity-limit guarantee was independently checked.

Exact weapon and utility-variant images: The selected Scavenger and V-R11 pictures show base models; no direct Hyena thermal-scope, Lazarus buff/explosion, doll HUD, Ray Gun held on this map or utility-weapon upgrade close-up is supplied. Their PaP approach photos are labeled honestly.

All fourteen existing BO1 cards and forty-three original steps were source-compared. Routes now distinguish Solo/co-op, four quest radios from five story recordings, photographed generators/vodka/horns, the Flinger and three Pack-a-Punch sites. Fifty-one selected photos were inspected. Gameplay, timers and complete map coverage are not certified.
